title: A normalized objectwise refinement comparison exists
statement: Under the ring-stage hypotheses of lem-sf-ring-open-map-invertibility, each finite-Tor input admits an isomorphism between the two open/proper objects whose adjunction transpose followed by refinementRestriction is the open adjunction unit.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I; Zheng Section 5, Lemma 5.13 and Constructions 5.14--5.15.

proof.text: Construct the finite coefficient comparison from the normalized open/proper refinement word. For completed integral coefficients construct the compatible strict reduction comparisons and take their normalized total-limit comparison. The coefficient realization identifies its transpose with the displayed open unit and restriction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I; normalized finite and integral coefficient constructions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalized_refinement_iso
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d) (s : RingStage.{max u v} l)
    (hi : (s.coefficients l).pull (c.i ≫ r.hom) =
      proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i r.hom
        ((s.coefficients l).ring d.Z) ((s.coefficients l).ring c.Z)
        ((s.coefficients l).ring X)
        ((s.coefficients l).pull r.hom) ((s.coefficients l).pull c.i))
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (s.stage l)) :
    ∃ ε : (PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) d.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K) ≅
        (PurCompactSupport.push (s.coefficients l) r.hom).obj
          ((PurCompactSupport.openExtension (s.coefficients l) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K)),
      (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) d.i).homEquiv _ _ ε.hom ≫
          PurCompactSupport.refinementRestriction (s.coefficients l) r hi
            ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K) =
        (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction (s.coefficients l) c.i).unit.app
          ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K)
